arithmetic: Complete warm reset-state prediction plus visual encoding and dense heads. Separate these FLOPs from optimizer throughput and overhead; no existing CNN comparison is inherited.
clipping: Retain actual pre-update group norms/factors and existing post-update/activity measurements separately; do not infer group clipping events from the global norm.
decision: A provisional optimizer candidate requires policy KL improvement in each paired seed and no worsening of mean value MSE. Report all losses, tradeoffs and failed cases regardless; no best-checkpoint or best-seed selection. Any later horizon/rate/propagation study needs its own contract.
name: group-clipping-analysis-v1
pairing: Compare candidate minus reference on identical validation indices within each seed, then average paired predictions per position before resampling opening families. Report every seed difference and its sample SD separately.
scope: All six fixed endpoints and all failures reported. Same reused V0 validation families; not an untouched-data test, matched-CNN result or playing-strength comparison.
uncertainty: Use the existing opening-family bootstrap: 1,000 resamples, seed 709. Report conditional family intervals and the three paired-seed differences/sample SD separately. The same validation families have been reused in earlier studies.
